summary: PREVIEW verification of Admin Licenses Revoke/Reactivate/Delete and Usage 'User' column. Backend: 4/4 pytest pass (auth gate, gift->revoke->reactivate->delete lifecycle with GET verification, 400/404 errors, usage email/name enrichment). Frontend (Playwright, admin cookie): Revoke opens AlertDialog, Cancel closes with no change, Confirm -> toast 'License revoked' + badge 'Revoked'; Reactivate restores to Active; UI-generated gift key -> Delete dialog -> Cancel keeps it, Confirm -> toast 'License permanently deleted' + row removed. Usage table headers start with 'User'; test-machine-abc row shows tester@example.com; other rows show 'Anonymous (free)'. No console errors. Everything works in preview, so the reported production 'nothing happens' problem is NOT reproducible from this code. Most likely the live site is running an older build that hasn't been redeployed.

minor.issue: Uses modified_count==0 -> 404 'License key not found'. Revoking an already revoked key (or reactivating an active one) wrongly returns 404. Use matched_count instead.

issues: 'Active' badge (default variant = red primary) looks nearly the same as the 'Revoked' destructive badge. Use green/emerald for Active.
